Thanks again for taking the call today — great to learn more about Acme's search and personalization roadmap. Per our discussion, I wanted to summarize the next steps and surface the security/compliance artifacts you requested so we can keep procurement moving.

Call recap (quick):
- Use case: product search re-ranking + site personalization (mix of batch embeddings + live ranking).
- Expected QPS: 150 peak, 40 sustained.
- Primary constraint: PCI-adjacent data/PII redaction & 1yr data retention policy.

Key asks from Acme for evaluation/procurement:
1) SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
2) Pen test summary or attestations
3) Sample audit logs (redacted) and retention policy
4) Confirmation of data deletion and KMS/HSM integrations for keys

Requested timeline: procurement aims to close tech/security review by 2026-03-31. Can you confirm stakeholders (economic buyer / procurement / security reviewer) and whether that timeline is realistic?

Planned next steps from our side:
- Loop in our security lead to provide SOC2/pen-test artifacts and answers to the retention/audit log questions (by EOD 3/22).
- Send a short mutual action plan and procurement checklist for Acme to share with Legal/Procurement.

If you can share the contact for procurement and the security reviewer, I will include them on the evidence email so we have a single thread for any questions.

Thanks,

Hi Tom / Alice / Procurement team —

Thanks for the clear ask and timeline. Attaching the requested artifacts and providing short answers below. Please note attachments are redacted where necessary. If you need full reports, we can arrange an NDA or a secure share.

Attachments included:
- SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf (redacted)
- pen_test_summary_2025.pdf (redacted)
- audit_logs_sample.csv (redacted, per-request metadata)

Short answers to your questions:
1) SOC 2 Type II: Yes — attached (period: 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31). The report covers our control environment for the Redwood hosted platform.

2) Pen test: We engage a third-party firm annually. The summary is attached; high-risk items from 2025 were mitigated as of 2025-11-15. We can provide the full remediation ticket list under an NDA.

3) Audit logs: The sample includes per-request metadata: request_id, timestamp, model_id, region, customer_id (hashed), and source IP (redacted in shared sample). Default retention: 90 days for hosted logs. For Dedicated/Private customers we support custom retention policies via configuration and can export longer-term logs to your storage under a contract.

4) Data retention & deletion: By default we retain ephemeral inference logs for 90 days (as noted above). We support data deletion requests and have an export+purge workflow for customer-managed data. For regulated customers we offer Private deployment options with customer-managed storage and KMS/HSM integrations.

5) PCI-adjacent guidance: We recommend tokenization or client-side redaction for any payment card fields. We do not recommend sending raw PANs to hosted endpoints. For high-risk workloads we can discuss Dedicated or Private deployment to isolate data.

Next steps we propose:
- Share the attached artifacts with Procurement and Security.
- If Acme wants the full (non-redacted) pen test or SOC 2, sign a standard NDA and we'll provide secure access.
- If a Zoom with Marcus (your security reviewer) would help, propose some times and we'll coordinate.

Happy to jump on a call if any of the answers need follow-up.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0110
